Class Client

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.network.client.Client
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelListener
public class Client extends Object implements ModelListener
Manages the connection to the server on the client side, handling network communication, sequence validation of incoming DTOs, and synchronizing the local SmallModel.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String tech, String host, int hostPort) throws IllegalStateException, ConnectException
      Connects the client to the server using the specified technology, host, and port.
      Parameters:
      tech - The connection technology to use ("RMI" or "TCP").
      host - The server host address.
      hostPort - The server port number.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If the client is already connected to a server.
      ConnectException - If the connection to the server fails.

    • connect

      public void connect(String tech, String host, int hostPort, int clientPort) throws IllegalStateException, ConnectException
      Connects the client to the server using the specified technology, host, server port, and specific client port.
      Parameters:
      tech - The connection technology to use ("RMI" or "TCP").
      host - The server host address.
      hostPort - The server port number.
      clientPort - The specific client port number to bind for RMI connections.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If the client is already connected to a server.
      ConnectException - If the connection to the server fails.
